units: <cite ref="Zevachim 22a:5">Zeb. 22ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 30:18">Ex. XXX, 18</cite>) <he>לנ׳ הקשתיו וכ׳</he> I compared it (the foot of the laver with the laver itself) with regard to its being of copper, but not with regard to anything else. Pesik. Ekhah, p. 122ᵇ <he>מטבעות של נ׳ וכ׳</he> silver-plated copper coins.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:10">Keth. VII, 10</cite>, v. <cite ref="R00797"><he>צָרַף</he></cite>; a. fr.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 10:3:2">Y. Keth. X, 33ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>להיות גובין מן הנ׳ וכ׳</he> to seize (for the widowhood) copper vessels and dining plates.
<cite ref="Shabbat 41a:8">Sabb. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>מפני שנְחוּשְׁתָּהּ מחממתה</he> because its double bottom gives out heat to warm the water (even after the removal of the coals).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:3">Kel. VIII, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 9:1">IX, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 9:3">3</cite> <he>נ׳ של תנור</he> the (copper) rim of the stove. [<cite ref="Yoma 38a:4">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite>, v. next w.]

senses.gloss: the polished, smooth side of skin (קֶלֶף). Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ top מקום נְחוּשְׁתּוֹ on its smooth side, opp. מקום שיער the hairy side.
